title: EXP-010-R3 — Clean Replay: Form Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: Independently replay the EXP-010 Form-level Caption recovery procedure on one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form. Starting from an already-live usable Mongoose session, prove the target absent, create exactly one Form, record its untouched Form-property baseline, change only the Form-level Caption to a controlled replay value, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to clean, close the Form through its ordinary Form-tab control, reopen it through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path in the same Designer/session context, and verify the Caption and all recorded comparison properties recover unchanged. This experiment concerns only Form-level Caption metadata; it does not test Button/component Caption editing or explain persistence mechanisms.

in_scope: Read EXP-010, EXP-010-R2, and the verified basic-form recipe before mutation.
Read-only preflight proving an already-live usable Web Client/Designer session, User editing scope, and no session-establishment or recovery action is required.
Prove the new target Form absent before creation using the supported visible Select Form inventory with a case-insensitive Name filter and a positive control.
Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form using the verified basic-form creation procedure with Save Template unchecked.
Capture the untouched Form-property baseline before Caption mutation, including Name, Caption, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, and ScopeName as visibly supported.
Change only the Form-level Caption to exactly `Form Property Caption Close Only Replay 2`.
Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save and verify the Designer returns to a clean state.
Close the target through its ordinary Form-tab close control with no unsaved-change prompt.
Reopen exactly the target through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path in the same Designer/session context.
Verify Name + ScopeType + ScopeName identify the same User-scoped Form and that Caption plus every recorded non-Caption comparison property match the saved state.
Perform a final read-only inventory/repository audit and record evidence under evidence/EXP-010-R3/ plus the EXP-010-R3 experiment record.
out_of_scope: Button or other component Caption editing, including any continuation or workaround for EXP-020.
Form Variables, FormSync, generated definition representations, scripts, events, IDOs, bindings, portals, or runtime behavior.
Explicit global-Form-object unload or IDO-metadata unload.
Physical database durability, cache eviction, commit-boundary, internal serialization, or causal explanations.
Testing why EXP-010-R2 required session recovery or why EXP-020's Button Caption editor transformed literal input.
Any change to prior experiment artifacts, including FX_ButtonCaptionLab01.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Do not create, modify, or delete any non-FX_ Mongoose artifact.
Do not modify any prior FX_ artifact, including FX_ButtonCaptionLab01.
Do not proceed past preflight if the Web Client or Designer requires any session-establishment or recovery action after the experiment begins.
Do not dismiss or bypass authentication, permission, conflict, or unexpected dirty-state prompts.
Do not create more than one target Form.
Do not change any Form property other than the target Form-level Caption after the untouched baseline is captured.
Do not Save more than once after the Caption mutation.
Do not invoke any explicit unload operation.
Do not reload the Designer page, replace the Designer session, close/reopen the Designer browser tab, or launch a new Designer instance.
Do not use direct URL navigation to reopen the target.
Do not use JavaScript evaluation, hidden controls, Ext internal stores/components, synthetic events, internal APIs, reverse-engineered requests, or direct SQL.
Do not modify recipes, environment documentation, AGENTS.md, or prior experiment records.
Do not classify success as proof of physical persistence, cache eviction, database durability, or behavior of Button/component Caption metadata.
prohibited_patterns: \b(Unload All Global Form Objects|Unload IDO Metadata With Forms)\b

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight visibly proves an already-live usable Designer/Web Client session in User scope, no session recovery is required, the inherited state does not require modifying any prior artifact, and FX_FormPropertyLab13 is absent under an applied case-insensitive Select Form Name filter with a visible positive control.
Exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form FX_FormPropertyLab13 is created with Save Template unchecked and is visibly open and clean; evidence identifies Name and User scope.
Before Caption mutation, visible evidence records the untouched target Form baseline: Name, Caption, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, and ScopeName.

Only the Form-level Caption is changed to exactly `Form Property Caption Close Only Replay 2`; exactly one ordinary Designer Save follows; post-Save evidence shows the Designer clean, Caption exact, and every recorded non-Caption baseline property unchanged.

FX_FormPropertyLab13 is closed through its ordinary Form-tab close control with no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt and without reload, unload, preference change, session replacement, or new Designer instance.
The target is reopened through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path in the same Designer/session context; evidence identifies the same User-scoped Form by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.
Post-reopen visible evidence shows Caption exactly `Form Property Caption Close Only Replay 2`, every recorded comparison property unchanged from AC-3/AC-4, and the Designer clean.

Final audit proves exactly one case-insensitive FX_FormPropertyLab13 exists, records the exact Save → ordinary Form-tab close → Form-menu recent-forms reopen sequence, confirms no prohibited action occurred, and confines repository changes to the EXP-010-R3 record plus evidence/EXP-010-R3/. If all prior checks pass, classify the EXP-010 ordinary Form-level Caption close/reopen procedure as replay_verified, bounded to this tested User-scope UI workflow.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261005-215424-QvhT. Rationale: EXP-010 established the Form-level Caption close/reopen procedure as observed, but EXP-010-R2 could not promote it because that run performed prohibited after-start session recovery even though the semantic Form behavior succeeded. A fresh replay is therefore the smallest high-value next experiment: it tests an already-observed procedure rather than working around EXP-020's separate Button-Caption editor blocker. The run must begin only if the Designer/Web Client session is already usable and User scope is visibly established; otherwise it blocks before mutation. Success would provide the missing accepted independent replay for Form-level Caption recovery across the ordinary Form-tab close/recent-forms reopen boundary.
